fluff.overview: The Com Guards field conventional infantry as a core component of their combined-arms formations, with Level I infantry units integrated into the same command structure alongside BattleMech, armor, and aerospace elements at every organizational level. Mechanized tracked Level I formations ride armored personnel carriers through terrain that would stop wheeled vehicles, providing all-terrain mobility with meaningful armor protection against battlefield hazards. These formations can advance alongside armored Level I units without falling behind on broken ground. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
